skill.name: set-up-woocommerce-chatgpt-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to set up profit or revenue bidding for WooCommerce in ChatGPT Ads. Check conversion delivery, configure order costs, and choose a starting target based on profit on ad spend (POAS).
skill.summary: Set up and verify profit-based bidding for WooCommerce campaigns in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance alerts and most shell alerts match ordinary documentation, not host discovery or shell substitution. Confirmed risks involve authenticated tool access, write retries, sensitive order reads, mutable remote instructions, and an unpinned installer. The workflow also gives conflicting guidance for handling credentials and does not clearly separate required setup from broader order imports and advertising connections.

remediation.issue: The agent workflow permits direct handling of live credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the secret-handling exception. Require people to enter keys in the verified Product Metrics interface or a protected credential picker that never exposes values to the assistant.

remediation.issue: The linked setup can expand data sharing beyond the requested campaign.
remediation.suggestion: Separate historical order imports and additional ad destinations from ChatGPT Ads setup. Disclose the data fields and recipients, verify consent, and get explicit approval before enabling each transfer.

remediation.issue: Authenticated tooling can read detailed orders and retry writes.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the workspace, store, and approved destination before using the CLI or MCP. Minimize returned order fields and limit write retries to the same approved operation.

remediation.issue: The fallback uses mutable documentation as workflow instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the reviewed setup instructions with each release. Treat fetched pages as reference material only and require separate approval for any actions they introduce.

remediation.issue: The installation example executes an unpinned package and retrieves a mutable skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and skill revision. Give the operator a way to verify both artifacts before running the installer.

content.user_title: Set Up Profit Bidding for WooCommerce in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A WooCommerce campaign can meet its revenue target and still lose money after costs. Use Product Metrics to verify profit conversions and choose a starting target for ChatGPT Ads.
actual_capabilities: Check setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP and identify steps that are already complete.
Guide the operator through connecting WooCommerce and an Ads pixel and verifying delivery with a test order.
Explain how product costs, payment fees, shipping, and cost estimates affect reported order profit.
Explain how to select the profit or revenue conversion in Ads Manager.
Suggest a starting profit-based target from the campaign's current POAS and identify checks before switching.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, the WooCommerce plugin, and access to WordPress Admin and ChatGPT Ads Manager for setup.
The operator creates and selects the campaign conversion in Ads Manager. The skill does not make that change.
Profit events require complete cost data and applicable consent. Missing costs can produce revenue-only events, and a loss is reported as zero profit.
ChatGPT Ads does not import historical orders or revise received events after later refunds. This skill does not cover customer-segment or lifetime value bidding.

use_cases.title: Set up the first profit conversion
use_cases.description: Confirm store access, consent settings, and costs before using a test order to verify the profit event.

use_cases.title: Plan a switch from revenue to profit
use_cases.description: Compare the two conversion options and use current campaign POAS to estimate a starting target for one campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing profit values
use_cases.description: Use consent, delivery, and cost checks to explain why an order appears as revenue without a profit event.

prompt_templates.title: Understand Profit Bidding
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Compare bidding on revenue and profit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain POAS and ROAS for my WooCommerce campaigns in ChatGPT Ads. List what I need before a test order. Do not connect accounts or request credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Review an existing Product Metrics connection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review setup status for my approved WooCommerce property in read-only mode. Tell me which steps are complete and which ones I need to perform in the browser.

prompt_templates.title: Find Missing Profit Events
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Revenue events arrive, but profit events do not.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use a consented test order to help diagnose the missing profit event. Check the cost source, additional costs, consent, and delivery status. Do not show customer details or change settings.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Campaign Switch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare starting targets using existing campaign data.
prompt_templates.prompt: My campaign reports a POAS of 1.5. Translate that into a starting target and explain how zero-valued losses and later refunds affect it. Outline one campaign test without changing my settings.

output_examples.input: My test order shows revenue but no profit. What should I check?
output: Confirm that the order has a product cost and that your additional costs are active.
Check that the test shopper granted the consent required for profit events.
Place another test order after correcting any gaps. Verify receipt before selecting the profit conversion.

output_examples.input: The campaign reports 1.5 profit on ad spend. What starting target should I consider?
output: Consider 150% as a starting target once the campaign uses the profit conversion.
Apply the change to one campaign in Ads Manager and review its results after a few weeks.
Compare reported profit with store records because losses report as zero and later refunds do not revise Ads events.

best_practices: Enter API keys and setup tokens only in the verified settings page that requires them.
Confirm costs and consent with a test order before selecting the campaign's profit conversion.
Review which data each destination receives and approve only the imports and connections needed for the requested setup.
anti_patterns: Copying a revenue-based target directly to a campaign that now bids on profit.
Selecting the profit conversion before confirming that Ads Manager received the test event.
Assuming reported profit includes losses below zero or refunds recorded after the event was sent.

faq.question: What is the difference between POAS and ROAS?
faq.answer: POAS compares contribution profit before ad spend with the cost of ads. ROAS compares revenue with that same cost.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. This workflow requires Product Metrics Pro and the Product Metrics plugin for WooCommerce.

faq.question: Which conversion should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose pm_order_profit for profit or order_created for revenue. You make the selection in ChatGPT Ads Manager.

faq.question: Why did an order arrive with revenue only?
faq.answer: Check for missing costs and verify that the shopper granted the required consent. Profit delivery depends on both.

faq.question: Does ChatGPT Ads import past orders or apply later refunds?
faq.answer: No. This integration does not import past orders into ChatGPT Ads or update previously delivered events after later refunds.

faq.question: Where do I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Enter it in the verified Product Metrics destination settings for your Ads pixel. Do not put it in a chat or prompt.
